name: [MySQL] 用户+部门+订单关联汇总
source_sql: SELECT u.id, u.name, d.name AS dept_name, u.salary, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM users u JOIN departments d ON u.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.name, d.name, u.salary ORDER BY u.id
target_sql: SELECT u.id, u.name, d.name AS dept_name, u.salary, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM users u JOIN departments d ON u.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.name, d.name, u.salary ORDER BY u.id
